email.subject: Quick fix for Salt Flat Co's website
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I looked at Salt Flat Co Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you booked jobs: there's no way to schedule an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just calls a competitor instead, and your hours aren't listed anywhere on the site, which makes people unsure if you're even open.

I fix local business sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and how I'd fix it? No pressure either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
